review.assessment: The change introduces a complete expression evaluator in `src/eval.rs` by splitting input into terms and additive operators, then combining them to produce a result. It processes these operators from right to left, effectively applying incorrect right-associativity instead of the required left-to-right grouping. As a result, expressions with multiple subtractions or mixed operators evaluate incorrectly.

findings.defect: Chained subtraction evaluates incorrectly due to right-to-left accumulation instead of left-to-right.
